name: Hamish James
life: “I still remember my first shop closing while I still had the keys.” Thursday often includes a stop at the corner outside Coastal Barber, where Hamish usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I bought the man's tools and lost my shop anyway. I have one plane left to return.
appearance: Hamish is easy to recognize by thick, tightly coiled hair and a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones. Usually dressed in a sand-colored linen shirt with a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case, Hamish steadies a cup with both hands while listening when listening.
personality: Hamish is patient with a person learning and fiercely impatient with somebody pretending to know. A half-finished job left where a beginner can see it is an invitation, as far as Hamish is concerned.
agenda: To return the one surviving plane.
family: Riley Macrae is Hamish’s half-sibling. Hamish leaves the first voice message. Riley calls back when there is finally a little privacy. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *A doctor moves away*, Riley says, “I asked my patients what mattered for years.”
connections: Anna Bishop (ledger creditor). They have different odds of recovering the dress and the one surviving tool.

reactions.situation: A creditor asks for a conversation without witnesses
reactions.response: Hamish finds a private time when both people can still have someone nearby if requested.

reactions.situation: A power cut leaves two neighbors waiting on the stairs
reactions.response: Hamish asks who can manage the stairs and who would rather wait by the landing, without attempting a move on their behalf.
